description.value: The Indian Oven is a sit-down Indian restaurant on the second floor of a Kitsilano building on West 4th Avenue, a well-travelled cycling corridor. The kitchen emphasizes authenticity, preparing every dish from scratch with hand-picked spices and locally sourced produce, and the menu spans appetizers, tandoori, a wide range of curries, and freshly baked breads. Online ordering and delivery are available, making it a convenient stop or meal-ahead option for cyclists passing through the neighbourhood.
